title: Time difference poses challenges to Duterte ICC trial

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The International Criminal Court’s (ICC) Pre-Trial Chamber III is preparing for significant logistical adjustments in the trial of former president Rodrigo Duterte as approximately 29 witnesses are set to testify through audio-visual link (AVL) from the Philippines. “I can tell you right now it’s about 29 total,” Senior Trial Lawyer Julian Nicholls said when asked about the number of video-link witnesses expected to give evidence. To preserve trial efficiency and manage courtroom presentation, Trial Chamber III Presiding Judge Joanna Korner instructed the prosecution to prioritize in-person testimonies before transitioning to remote links. “For reasons that I needn’t go into, […]...
